text:
Hector Ramos: quick scrub: final checklist for the marketplace go-live with Nimbus + SI partners. we have 48h. main open items: hero assets, sandbox creds, embargo exceptions, and day-0 rota.
Leah Wong: creative: hero + badge + 3:2 crop needed. if we don't get vendor PNGs by Mon noon we'll use neutral hero + "badge pending" pill.
Priya Shah: legal: co-brand consent doc is ready. NDA addendum template is uploaded. partnerships to collect signoffs.
Glen Harper: ops: sandbox ready but need tester emails and exact SKU CSV. provisioning script expects columns: sku_id, region, model_variant. can someone drop the CSV?
Maya Patel: partnerships will compile SKU CSV tonight. Hector can you confirm which SI contacts will be in the sandbox?
Hector Ramos: SI contacts: samir.patel@si.co, tina.li@si.co, and jose@si.co. low load smoke only.
ops-bot: provisioning note: sandbox will be created with 2 GPUs, 60GB NVMe, egress locked. creds expire 48h after creation.
Glen Harper: ops asks that SI lead rotate creds once and confirm in thread. we'll automate after that.
Leah Wong: marketing asks for a 1-line vendor quote and perf blurb (p95 latency) for the blog. Nimbus AM said they'll provide a quote by EOD Mon.
marketing-bot: embargo policy reminder: one NDA-protected early hands-on allowed. PR must approve outlet; legal must have signed addendum before access.
Priya Shah: legal note: NDA addendum blocks screenshots until public release. also forbids sharing internal benchmarks.
Hector Ramos: should we allow early hands-on for "EdgeToday"? PR/marketing please confirm.
Maya Patel: marketing - please vet EdgeToday. if approved, partnerships will send NDA and coordinate access.
Leah Wong: creative fallback: GIF install will be optional. we'll design a static PNG if MP4 arrives late.
Glen Harper: ops fallback: add routing policy for first 72h to route heavy inference to Dedicated pool and enable auto-fallback to quantized variant if p95 > 400ms.
Maya Patel: Tom (cc'ed) earlier suggested 48h but ops prefers 72h. product sign-off needed.
Priya Shah: confirm we need co-brand consent for a vendor quote on the public blog. get signature before publishing.
marketing-bot: timeline snapshot:
```
- Mon AM: final assets + SKU CSV in repo
- Mon noon: NDA signatures (if early hands-on)
- Mon EOD: sandbox provisioned + SI smoke tests
- Tue 17:00 PT: landing page staging cutover
- Wed 07:00 PT: public blog + press
- Wed 09:00 PT: marketplace listing live
- Thu 11:00 PT: post-launch analytics review
```
Hector Ramos: final blockers?
Glen Harper: need SKU CSV and confirmation of routing window length (48h vs 72h).
Leah Wong: need vendor PNGs by Mon noon or fallbacks go live.
Maya Patel: I'll DM Nimbus AM about assets and badge and post consolidated checklist link here at 13:00 PT. if legal/assets slip we'll push inner validation but keep public date if feasible.
ops-bot: reminder created: Marketplace staging deploy Tue 17:00 PT (approvers: partnerships, eng-platform, marketing).
